title: Temperature fault (too hot or too cold)
causes: The machine has got too hot.
The room has been colder than about 10 °C (50 °F) for a long time.
steps: Switch the machine off with the On/Off button.
If it was overheated, leave it off for about one hour to cool.
If the room was cold, warm the room to above 15 °C (60 °F) and wait a while before using the machine again.
Switch on and try again.
technician: If the fault comes back after cooling down or warming up the room, book a Miele service visit.

title: Electronics fault
causes: The machine's electronic control has a technical fault.
steps: Do not try to repair the machine yourself.
Note the code and your model number.
Check the operating instructions for your model.
technician: This fault cannot be fixed by the owner. Book a Miele technician.

title: Water is not being drawn in
causes: The water container is not seated correctly.
The small filter under the water container is dirty.
Limescale is building up inside the machine.
steps: Fill the water container about three-quarters with fresh drinking water.
Take the container out and put it back 10–20 times so it seats properly.
On newer machines, remove the container, unscrew the cap underneath, and rinse the filter and seal with plain water (no detergent).
Refit the filter with the cross facing up and the seal opening facing down, then screw the cap tight.
Descale the machine as described in the manual.
technician: If the machine still does not take in water, contact Miele Service.

title: Too little water is being drawn in
causes: The water container is not seated correctly.
The filter under the water container is dirty.
Limescale is building up inside the machine.
steps: Refill the water container about three-quarters with fresh water and refit it.
Remove and reinsert the container 10–20 times.
Rinse the intake filter under the container with plain water and refit it.
Descale the machine following the manual.
technician: If F17 keeps returning, contact Miele Service.

title: Brew unit cannot process the coffee
causes: Too much pre-ground coffee was put in the chute.
The coffee grinder channel is blocked with residue.
steps: Switch the machine off, wait 2 minutes and switch it on again.
When using pre-ground coffee, add only one measured portion at a time (check the scoop size for your model).
Vacuum out the ground coffee chute, using the supplied vacuum attachment if you have one. Do this about once a year.
technician: If the message stays after cleaning, contact Miele Service.

title: Brew unit cannot return to its home position
causes: The brew unit is dirty or the coffee ejector is out of position.
Some coffees grind to a large volume and overfill the brew unit.
On some models the drip tray was removed while the brew unit was moving.
steps: Confirm the message with OK and switch the machine off.
Unplug the machine for 2 minutes, then plug it back in.
Take out the brew unit and rinse it under running water.
Push the coffee ejector back into its correct position, close the door without the brew unit, and switch on so the drive resets.
Insert the brew unit when the display asks for it.
If it happens again, use less coffee or a finer grind.
technician: If F73 persists after resetting and rinsing the brew unit, book a Miele repair.

title: Valve adjustment fault
causes: A fault occurred while a valve was being adjusted.
Limescale on the valve.
steps: Switch the machine off briefly and back on.
If the code stays, run the descaling programme from the Maintenance menu and let it finish.
Switch off and on again after descaling.
technician: If F74 remains after descaling, contact Miele Service.

title: Capsule jammed
causes: A coffee capsule is jammed.
The capsule was not pushed fully onto the capsule plate and may be damaged.
steps: Confirm the message with OK.
Open the door, empty the grounds container and refit it.
Remove and refit the carousel runners, then close the door.
If it persists, switch off at the main switch, remove the grounds container, runners and capsule plate, and look for the stuck capsule.
If the capsule is stuck higher up, free it with a wooden spoon handle. Never put your fingers into the brew unit.
Reassemble the parts and switch back on.
technician: If capsules keep jamming, contact Miele Service.

title: Capsule jammed
causes: A coffee capsule is jammed.
The capsule was not pushed fully onto the capsule plate and may be damaged.
steps: Confirm the message with OK.
Open the door, empty the grounds container and refit it.
Remove and refit the carousel runners, then close the door.
If it persists, switch off at the main switch, remove the grounds container, runners and capsule plate, and look for the stuck capsule.
If the capsule is stuck higher up, free it with a wooden spoon handle. Never put your fingers into the brew unit.
Reassemble the parts and switch back on.
technician: If capsules keep jamming, contact Miele Service.

title: Valve initialisation fault
causes: A valve did not finish its start-up check.
steps: Switch the machine off and unplug it.
Wait a short while, then plug it back in.
Switch on and see if the code has cleared.
technician: If F77 keeps appearing, book a Miele repair.

title: Valve initialisation fault
causes: A valve did not finish its start-up check.
steps: Switch the machine off and unplug it.
Wait a short while, then plug it back in.
Switch on and see if the code has cleared.
technician: If F226 keeps appearing, book a Miele repair.

title: Valve initialisation fault
causes: A valve did not finish its start-up check.
steps: Switch the machine off and unplug it.
Wait a short while, then plug it back in.
Switch on and see if the code has cleared.
technician: If F352 keeps appearing, book a Miele repair.

title: Maintenance needed (brew unit or scale)
causes: The brew unit has not been cleaned well enough.
Manual descaling was skipped or done incorrectly.
The water hardness setting is too low.
steps: Remove the brew unit and rinse it by hand in warm water without detergent. Do this weekly.
Wipe coffee residue from the brew unit filters and vacuum loose grounds from inside the machine.
Run a manual descaling with Miele descaling tablets and follow the display prompts.
Set the correct water hardness in the Settings menu (ask your water supplier if unsure).
technician: If F82 returns after cleaning and descaling, contact Miele Service.

title: Central spout or cup rim sensor problem
causes: The central spout dispensing unit is not assembled or fitted correctly.
The cup rim sensor is faulty.
steps: Pull off the stainless steel cover and remove the dispensing unit.
Take apart the spout parts, clean them if needed, and reassemble them so every part sits tightly.
Refit the dispensing unit and the cover.
technician: If the fault persists, the cup rim sensor may need replacing. Order it through Miele Service.

title: Milk valve problem
causes: The milk valve is clogged.
The milk pipework holder is not fitted correctly.
steps: Open the door and remove the milk valve cover and milk pipework as described in the manual.
Rinse the milk hoses well under running water.
Remove the milk valve holder, take it apart and clean the parts.
Refit the holder so it clicks into place.
technician: If F307 persists after cleaning the milk system, contact Miele Service.

title: Brew unit cannot reach its position
causes: The brew unit is dirty and cannot move back to its home position.
The coffee is ground too coarsely.
Too much coffee is being used.
steps: Press OK to confirm.
Remove the brew unit and rinse it under running water without detergent.
Push the coffee ejector into the correct position.
Switch on without the brew unit so the drive resets, then insert it when asked.
Choose a finer grind or reduce the amount of coffee.
If the brew unit cannot be removed, switch off, wait about 2 minutes and switch on again.
technician: If the message keeps coming back, contact Miele Service.

title: Manual descaling is due
causes: The water lines need descaling, even when a descaling cartridge is used.
How often depends on use and water hardness.
steps: Run the manual descaling programme as described in your manual.
Use Miele descaling products.
Descale regularly based on how much you use the machine and your water hardness.
technician: If the message stays after a full descaling, contact Miele Service.

title: Machine is not drawing water while filling
causes: The water container is not seated properly.
Limescale is blocking the water pipes.
The water hardness setting is wrong.
The float on the side of the container is stuck.
steps: Remove the water container and push it back firmly.
Run a descaling cycle.
Check that the water hardness setting matches your water.
Shake the container to check the float moves freely; clean the container if it sticks.
technician: If the machine still will not fill, book a Miele technician.

code: Check water inlet and empty water container
title: No water supply detected
causes: The tap feeding a plumbed-in machine is closed.
The water inlet hose is kinked.
The float switch on the water container is stuck.
steps: Open the valve for the plumbed water connection.
Straighten the inlet hose.
Shake the water container to check the float moves; clean the container if it does not.
technician: If the message persists, contact Miele Service.

title: Inside of the machine is very dirty
causes: Coffee residue has built up inside the appliance.
steps: Switch the machine off and remove the drip tray, grounds container and brew unit (infuser) if your model allows it.
Clean the inside of the machine thoroughly following the user manual or the app.
Refit all parts and switch on again.
technician: If the alarm stays after a full clean, contact De'Longhi customer service.

aliases: NOT ENOUGH COFFEE CONSULT MANUAL OR CUSTOMER SERVICES
title: Beans not detected
causes: The bean-level sensors are dusty and do not detect the beans.
steps: Switch the machine off.
Gently clean the bean sensors with a cotton bud to remove dust.
Switch on and try again.
technician: If the message continues after cleaning the sensors, contact De'Longhi customer service.

title: Grind is too fine
causes: The grinder is set too fine, so coffee flows slowly or not at all.
steps: Open the machine settings and use the grinder adjustment function.
Set the grind slightly coarser.
Brew a few cups to let the new setting take effect.
technician: If coffee still does not flow on a coarser setting, contact De'Longhi customer service.

title: Machine has overheated
causes: The machine has been used continuously for a long time.
steps: Stop making drinks.
Let the machine cool down before using it again.
technician: If the message appears even after the machine has cooled, contact De'Longhi customer service.

aliases: MACHINE COOLING FAULT CONSULT MANUAL OR CUSTOMER SERVICES
title: Machine is not cooling correctly
causes: A fault is stopping the machine from cooling properly.
steps: Press OK to go back to the home screen.
Avoid making more than about 10 coffees in a row.
technician: If the fault message keeps returning, contact De'Longhi customer service.

aliases: WATER CIRCUIT EMPTY PRESS OK TO START FILLING
title: Water circuit needs filling
causes: The internal water circuit is empty and must be primed.
steps: Make sure the water tank is filled and fitted.
Place a container of at least 100 ml under the hot water/steam spout.
Press OK. The machine fills the circuit and stops by itself.
technician: If the message keeps coming back, contact De'Longhi customer service.

title: Brew unit not detected
causes: The infuser (brew unit) was not refitted correctly after cleaning.
steps: Switch the machine off.
Remove the infuser and slide it back in until it sits fully in place.
Close the service door and switch on.
technician: If the machine still does not detect a correctly fitted infuser, contact De'Longhi customer service.

aliases: DESCALING NEEDED PRESS OK TO START 45 MIN
title: Descaling is due
causes: Limescale has built up and the machine must be descaled.
steps: Prepare De'Longhi descaler and a large container.
Press OK to start descaling (about 45 minutes) and follow the prompts.
Or press ESC to postpone it for now.
technician: If descaling cannot be completed, contact De'Longhi customer service.

aliases: SELECT A MILDER TASTE OR REDUCE PRE GROUND COFFEE QUANTITY
title: Too much coffee used
causes: Too much coffee was used for the drink.
steps: Choose a milder aroma setting.
If using pre-ground coffee, add less.
Press OK or wait for the message to clear.
technician: If the message appears on every drink with a mild setting, contact De'Longhi customer service.

code: Please clean brewing unit, then replace
title: Brewing unit needs cleaning
causes: The brewing unit is dirty.
Too much pre-ground coffee was used.
The brewing unit mechanism has become stiff.
steps: Switch the machine off and remove the brewing unit.
Rinse it by hand and let it dry, as described in the manual.
Use no more than two level spoons of pre-ground coffee.
Refit the brewing unit until it locks.
technician: If the message returns right after cleaning, contact Siemens service.

title: Machine needs a restart
causes: The machine is too warm.
The brewing unit is dirty.
steps: Switch the machine off and let it cool.
Clean the brewing unit.
Switch on again.
technician: If the message keeps appearing, contact Siemens service.

title: Descaling was not effective
causes: The wrong descaler or too little descaler was used.
There is heavy scale in the machine.
steps: Use only a descaler approved for the machine, in the right amount.
Run the descaling programme again.
technician: If the message stays after repeating descaling, contact Siemens service.

title: Machine is too hot
causes: The appliance has overheated.
steps: Switch the machine off.
Leave it off for about 30 minutes, then switch on.
technician: If it overheats again soon after, contact Siemens service.

title: Appliance fault
causes: The machine has detected an internal fault.
steps: Switch the machine off and on once to see if the message clears.
Note the exact message and your model number.
technician: Contact Siemens Home Appliances Service; this needs a technician.

code: Refill with still water or change filter
title: Water not detected
causes: The water tank is not seated correctly.
Sparkling water is in the tank.
The float in the tank is stuck.
A new filter was not rinsed, has air in it, or is old.
steps: Refit the water tank correctly.
Empty the tank and refill with fresh still tap water.
Remove and clean the tank so the float moves freely.
Hold the filter under water until no more bubbles appear, then refit it.
Replace an old filter with a new one.
technician: If the message stays with a full, correctly fitted tank, contact Siemens service.

title: Drip tray message stays on
causes: The tray was emptied while the machine was switched off.
The drip tray is dirty.
steps: Switch the machine on, then remove and refit the drip tray.
Clean the drip tray thoroughly.
technician: If the message stays with a clean, empty tray, contact Siemens service.

title: Beans not reaching the grinder
causes: Oily beans are sticking and not falling into the grinder.
steps: Tap the bean container gently.
Try a less oily coffee.
When the container is empty, wipe it out with a dry cloth.
technician: If the grinder still does not take beans, contact Siemens service.

title: Brewing unit not detected
causes: The brewing unit or its cover is not fitted correctly.
steps: Check that the brewing unit is in place and locked.
Push the red lever up to the left.
Refit the brewing unit cover.
technician: If the message persists with the unit fitted, contact Siemens service.

title: Supply voltage out of range
causes: The mains voltage is too high or too low.
steps: Use the machine only on a normal 220–240 V supply.
Try a different socket without an extension lead.
technician: If the message appears on a normal supply, have an electrician check it or contact Siemens service.

code: Error in water system. Please restart appliance
title: Water system error
causes: The appliance has detected a fault in the water system.
steps: Unplug the machine.
Wait about 10 seconds and plug it back in.
technician: If the error returns after restarting, contact Siemens service.

title: Combined descaling and cleaning is due
causes: Scale is still present even with filtered water.
The wrong descaler or too little was used.
A service programme was not completed.
steps: Fit a new water filter and set the correct water hardness.
Use only suitable descaling tablets. Do not use vinegar or citric acid.
Run the full calc'nClean or special rinsing programme to the end.
technician: If the reminder appears far too often after these steps, contact Siemens service.

title: Appliance fault
causes: The machine has detected an internal fault.
steps: Follow any instructions shown on the display.
Switch off and on once to see if it clears.
technician: If E0510 remains, book a Bosch engineer through the repair service.

title: Clock reset after power loss
causes: There was a power cut.
The machine was switched off at the mains.
steps: Check the power supply is working.
Set the correct time as shown in your user manual.
technician: If the clock keeps resetting with a stable supply, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Supply voltage out of range
causes: The mains voltage is too high or too low.
steps: Try the machine on another socket without an extension lead.
Ask your electricity supplier about your supply voltage.
technician: Have a qualified electrician check the supply; if it is fine, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Machine is overheating
causes: The machine has not been descaled often enough.
More water is put in than the drinks need.
Low-quality beans are used.
steps: Switch off and leave the machine for at least 30 minutes.
Descale the machine.
Fill only as much water as you need.
Use good-quality coffee beans.
technician: If the message returns, contact Bosch customer service or book a repair.

title: Milk container not detected
causes: The container is outside the sensor's range.
The sensor does not recognise the container material, such as a carton.
steps: Move the container to the right edge so the sensor sees it.
Answer YES on the display if asked.
Use the milk container supplied with the machine.
technician: If the original container is still not detected, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Descaling is due
causes: Limescale has built up, especially in hard water areas.
Impurities in unfiltered water.
steps: Descale with a Bosch-approved descaler.
Fit a water filter.
Clean and descale on a regular schedule.
technician: If the message keeps showing after descaling, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Brewing unit needs cleaning
causes: The brewing unit is dirty.
Too much pre-ground coffee was used.
The brewing unit mechanism is stiff.
steps: Remove and clean the brewing unit as described in Bosch's guide.
Use no more than two level spoons of pre-ground coffee.
technician: If the message returns right after cleaning, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Beans not reaching the grinder
causes: Oily beans stick and do not fall into the grinder.
steps: Tap the bean container lightly.
Try a different, less oily bean.
Empty the container and wipe it with a dry cloth.
technician: If the message stays with a full container, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Drip tray message stays on
causes: The drip tray is dirty and wet.
The tray was emptied while the machine was off, so it was not detected.
steps: Remove the drip tray and clean and dry it.
Switch the machine on.
Remove the tray and refit it while the machine is on.
technician: If the message stays with a clean, empty tray, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Heating blocked after exposure to cold
causes: The machine was left in a cold room, for example overnight with the heating off.
steps: Move the machine to a warm room.
Fill the water tank with warm water to speed things up.
Switch the machine on again every 5–10 minutes; allow up to 30 minutes.
technician: If Error 2 appears during the day after the machine has already made coffee, it needs a JURA workshop repair.

title: Machine too cold to heat
causes: The machine was exposed to cold for a long time, so heating is disabled for safety.
steps: Let the machine warm up to room temperature.
Switch it on again.
technician: If the error stays at normal room temperature, contact JURA customer support.

title: Brewing area blocked
causes: The round metal sieve in the brewing area is clogged with coffee.
steps: Switch the machine off and unplug it.
Remove the drip tray and grounds container.
Wipe the round metal sieve in the brewing area with a dry cloth.
Plug in, switch on and run a cleaning cycle with a JURA tablet. Repeat if needed.
technician: If Error 8 remains after cleaning, contact JURA customer service.

title: Coffee funnel blocked
causes: Ground coffee has built up and blocked the coffee funnel.
steps: Switch the machine off and remove the brew group.
Clear the funnel with the handle of a spoon.
Refit the brew group and switch on.
Set the grinder to a coarser setting.
technician: If the code returns after clearing the funnel, contact Philips Consumer Care.

title: Brew group problem
causes: The brew group is clogged or not greased.
steps: Switch the machine off and remove the brew group.
Rinse the brew group under the tap.
Grease it as shown in the Philips video.
Push it back in until it clicks and switch on.
technician: If the error stays after cleaning and greasing, contact Philips Consumer Care.

title: Brew group not correctly placed
causes: The brew group is not locked into position.
steps: Switch the machine off.
Remove the brew group, rinse it, and refit it until you hear a click.
Switch the machine on.
technician: If the brew group will not lock in, contact Philips Consumer Care.

title: Air or blockage in the water circuit
causes: Air is trapped in the water circuit.
Beans or particles are in the water tank compartment.
The water filter is new and not prepared, or clogged.
Limescale is blocking the circuit.
steps: Switch off, remove the water tank and check its compartment for beans or bits.
Switch on and dispense 2–3 cups of hot water.
Remove the AquaClean/Brita filter and try again; prepare or replace it.
Rinse the brew group.
If it clears after a few hours off, descale with Philips/Saeco descaler.
technician: If code 05 keeps returning, contact Philips Consumer Care.

title: Machine adjusting to room temperature
causes: The machine needs to adapt to the room temperature.
steps: Leave the machine at room temperature for a while.
Switch it off and on again.
technician: If the code does not clear, contact Philips Consumer Care.

title: Machine overheated
causes: The machine has become too hot.
steps: Switch the machine off.
Wait about 60 minutes before switching it on again.
technician: If it overheats again, contact Philips Consumer Care.

title: Machine adjusting from transport temperature
causes: The machine is adjusting from transport temperature to room temperature.
steps: Let the machine reach room temperature.
Switch it off for 30 minutes, then switch it on.
technician: If the code persists at room temperature, contact Philips Consumer Care.

title: Machine fault (Lattissima One)
causes: The machine has detected a fault and switches itself off.
steps: Switch the machine off and unplug it for a short time.
Plug it in and try once more.
technician: If all buttons blink again, the machine needs repair. Contact Nespresso.

title: Descaling is due (Lattissima One)
causes: The machine has reached the usage limit for descaling.
steps: Descale the machine with Nespresso descaler, following the descaling section of the manual.
technician: If the alert stays on after a full descaling, contact Nespresso.

title: Milk system needs cleaning (Lattissima One)
causes: The milk system needs cleaning.
steps: Take the milk system apart.
Wash the parts on the top rack of a dishwasher, or by hand as the manual describes.
Reassemble it.
technician: If the alert stays on after cleaning, contact Nespresso.

title: Descaling is due
causes: The machine has counted enough hot water and steam use to need descaling.
steps: Run the descaling programme when the alert appears.
Use the descaler Krups recommends.
technician: If the alert keeps appearing straight after descaling, contact Krups customer service.

title: Coffee circuit needs cleaning
causes: After a set number of coffees, the coffee circuit needs degreasing.
steps: Start the cleaning programme as soon as the alert shows.
Use the cleaning tablets Krups recommends.
technician: If the cleaning programme will not run or finish, contact Krups customer service.

title: Software fault
causes: The machine software has a fault.
steps: Switch the machine off with the On/Off button.
Switch it on again.
technician: If System error stays after restarting, contact the Melitta hotline.
